[电] 波形, 棱皱

corrugations.definition:
n. a ridge on a corrugated surface
n. the act of shaping into parallel ridges and grooves
corrugations.translation: n. 起皱；皱状；灌水沟；波纹成形

corrugator.definition:
n. A muscle which contracts the skin of the forehead into
   wrinkles.
corrugator.translation:
n. 皱眉肌
[医] 皱眉肌

corrupt.definition:
v. corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
v. alter from the original
a. lacking in integrity
s. containing errors or alterations
corrupt.translation:
a. 腐败的, 贪污的, 讹误充斥的
vt. 使腐烂, 腐蚀, 使恶化
vi. 腐烂, 堕落

corrupt practices.translation: [法] 贪污行为, 舞弊, 行贿

corrupt the minds of.translation: 腐蚀…的心灵,毒害…的思想

corrupted.definition: s. ruined in character or quality
corrupted.translation: a. 毁坏的；腐败的；崩溃的

corrupter.definition:
n. One who corrupts; one who vitiates or taints; as, a
   corrupter of morals.

corruptibility.definition: n. the capability of being corrupted
corruptibility.translation: n. 腐败性, 易腐败的倾向, 堕落性

corruptible.translation: a. 易腐败的, 易堕落的, 可收买的

corruptibly.translation: adv. 易腐败[堕落] 地

corrupting.definition:
s. seducing into corrupt practices
s. harmful to the mind or morals
s. that infects or taints
corrupting.translation: v. （使）败坏( corrupt的现在分词 ); （使）腐化; 引起（计算机文件等的）错误; 破坏

corruption.definition:
n. decay of matter (as by rot or oxidation)
n. moral perversion; impairment of virtue and moral principles
n. destroying someone's (or some group's) honesty or loyalty; undermining moral integrity
n. inducement (as of a public official) by improper means (as bribery) to violate duty (as by commiting a felony)
corruption.translation:
n. 腐败, 堕落, 贪污
[计] 论误

corruptionist.definition: n. One who corrupts, or who upholds corruption.
corruptionist.translation: n. 行贿的人, 舞弊政治家

corruptions.definition:
plural of corruption
n. decay of matter (as by rot or oxidation)
n. moral perversion; impairment of virtue and moral principles
n. destroying someone's (or some group's) honesty or loyalty; undermining moral integrity
n. inducement (as of a public official) by improper means (as bribery) to violate duty (as by commiting a felony)
corruptions.translation:
(corruption 的复数) n. 腐败, 堕落, 贪污
[计] 论误

corruptive.definition: s. tending to corrupt or pervert
corruptive.translation: a. 使腐败的, 腐败性的, 使堕落的

corruptly.translation: adv. 腐败（堕落）地, 可被收买的

corruptness.definition: n. The quality of being corrupt.

corrupts.definition:
v corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
v make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
v place under suspicion or cast doubt upon
v alter from the original
corrupts.translation: v. （使）败坏( corrupt的第三人称单数 ); （使）腐化; 引起（计算机文件等的）错误; 破坏
